family.shared_definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves used for storing domestic goods
family.neutral_stem: Searching for extra dishes, he opened
family.semantic_notes: Cupboard is frequent in British English and specifically for kitchen food/dish storage, while cabinet is more common in American English.
